release_notes: Every purchased key now rolls a random direction and arc once, then keeps them permanently across placement, concerts, and saves.
Auto-aim and per-hit randomness are removed: each key launches every ball along the same predictable path.
Keys now visibly lean, display their fixed angles, and show a trajectory preview while being moved so players can connect pipelines.
Existing layouts migrate safely to the new layout format with a working C→E→G starter pipeline.
Updated the Latest Releases progression discussion to build on fixed-angle pipeline strategy without implementing new progression systems.
